caseName: United States v. First National Bancorporation, Inc.
caseNameFull: United States v. First National Bancorporation, Inc.

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. Colo. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 405 U. S. 915.] Motion of New York State Banking Department for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
